Creates a physics world of its own and returns its handle. A world holds rigid bodies and simulates them; bodies of different worlds never touch each other, which is how effects that would need a lot of work with boolean geometry (a region that only some things collide with, a second set of rules) are done. The default world, number 0, always exists once it is used and can not be freed.
@param max_bodies How many bodies the world can hold, 0 for 10240. Memory is reserved for them, so do not ask for far more than needed.
@returns The handle of the world.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
